title: Retain the OPFS size query after complete writes
question: Can the size from an acknowledged full OPFS write save complete-Run time with the storage ledger intact?
summary: The three 1.265 GB paired effects range from a 0.149-second cost to a 0.086-second saving. The median saving is 0.007 seconds, below the frozen 0.200-second gate.

workloads: Persistent bundled Chromium on WSL2 ext4 with the same feature-free WASM in both arms. Fixed 32 MiB small snapshot and 128 MiB, 49-run Uniform then Partition spill.

validation.summary: Independent output readback verifies exact fields, IDs, partition membership, manifest, row and byte limits, marker and workspace retirement. Large pairs retain matching sort and cumulative logical temporary bytes.

limitations: Persistent Chromium on one host, with uncontrolled warm caches and synthetic fixtures. Aggregate bridge counters give operation counts and bytes.
exclusions: Individual size query elapsed time, incognito and other OPFS backends, native timing and physical device I/O.
